messages:
maria: hey folks — quick Q. we have a KMS grant that was created manually ages ago which lets the vectorizer svc SA Decrypt. i want to import that grant into terraform and then tighten access by requiring an encryption-context key (env=prod) propagated via session tags. is that doable with aws_kms_grant or do we need to change the key policy? any IRSA session-tag gotchas?
josh: short: grants don't support kms:EncryptionContext conditions. you can put those conditions on the key policy. importing the grant into TF is fine, but tightening by encryption-context needs a policy patch on the key itself.
samir: @maria also watch the difference between session tags vs principal tags. session tags need to be present on the STS session (AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity). many problems come from the OIDC flow not setting the tag you expect.
olivia: high level — if you want to gate by a session tag, that tag must actually be added to the session. that means the role trust or the caller needs to allow adding tags to the session. for IRSA we usually rely on `aws:PrincipalTag/...` in the key policy (tags added by the role at creation time) or pass tags via sts if configured.
josh: quick example we used before (key policy fragment):

```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/vec-irsa-role"},
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {
    "StringEquals": {
      "kms:EncryptionContext:env": "prod",
      "aws:principalTag/team": "vectorizer"
    }
  }
}
```

this sits on the key policy. grants are separate and can be imported into TF as `aws_kms_grant` if needed.
maria: ok so plan: 1) import existing grant into TF, 2) add a key-policy change requiring `kms:EncryptionContext:env=prod` and a principal tag, 3) test in staging. two q's: will TF apply blow up if grant/principal still exists but policy now denies decrypt? and how to test without breaking production?
samir: TF apply won't error just because policy is stricter — it will apply the policy change. if the policy makes decrypt impossible for the current principal, requests will start failing. so test in staging first, or add the condition with a second clause allowing a fallback for a short maintenance window.
olivia: for testing we do: create a staging key + policy change, then simulate the token with `aws sts assume-role --role-arn .. --serial-number .. --token-code .. --tags Key=env,Value=prod` (or use local `aws sts assume-role` to pass TagSpecification) and run `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://... --encryption-context env=prod`. also check EKS IRSA: confirm the OIDC provider and `aud`/`sub` mapping passes tag or that you use `aws:PrincipalTag` instead.
infra-bot: terraform plan check: modules/kms shows 1 importable aws_kms_grant resource and 1 aws_kms_key policy to be updated in staging. confirm when ready to import.
maria: thanks all — i'll import the grant into the infra repo, open a PR with the key policy change targeting staging key, and add integration tests for decrypt with `env=prod`. will ping for review. :thumbsup:
